title: Pomodoro Timer
---
Build a single-page pomodoro timer with start, pause and reset controls, alternating 25-minute work and 5-minute break sessions, and a counter showing how many work sessions were finished today (persisted in local storage and reset on a new day).
emma:
- Start, pause, and reset controls for the timer
- Automatic alternation between 25-minute work and 5-minute break sessions
- Display of remaining time for the current session
- Counter of completed work sessions for today
- Counter saved in local storage and reset when the date changes
- Look and feel: minimal single page, large timer readout, clear controls
